fields: min_height/max_height: finite strictly increasing float64 inclusive bounds
step: finite positive float64 UI step only
showcase_height_profile.binding: Deep-copied at showcase entry and per state; initial/reset/path reload share entry calibration
showcase_height_profile.saved_contract: schema 10 actual height remains authoritative; no step quantization; schema 1-5 historical missing height is 1.34; out-of-range legacy fill rejected atomically
showcase_height_profile.coordinate: actor-rest Y, distinct from hosiery geometry candidate domain

fields: rgb: PackedStringArray with three six-digit hex RGB values per slot
showcase_palette_profile.slot_contract: 0 disables garment dye; -1 is user custom color, not an authored slot; same-identity slot order is persistent
showcase_palette_profile.binding: Deep-copied at showcase entry; UI and initial/reset/path-reload state use the same snapshot
showcase_palette_profile.save_contract: Schema 10 unchanged; saved RGB is authoritative; historical migration defaults are not author overrides

showcase_camera_profile.coordinate_space: display-height-aligned actor space, Y up, default camera at target +Z
showcase_camera_profile.validation: Finite heights and offsets; finite positive distances; finite FOV within 1..179; finite pressure_target
showcase_camera_profile.binding: Deep-copied per showcase instance before camera creation; not serialized in schema 10
showcase_camera_profile.scope: Numeric validity does not prove framing, motion coverage or second-character acceptance

face_atlas_profile.required_when: painted-eye accent/round-eye, diagnostic replacement, symbolic skin cleanup or complete showcase
face_atlas_profile.optional_when: base rendering only; atlas operations disabled without explicit calibration
face_atlas_profile.coordinate_space: (UV.x, 1 - UV.y) normalized Face fragment texture coordinates; no fixed 512px layout
face_atlas_profile.replacement_domains: A: U < max_u && V < max_v; B: U > min_u && low_v < V < high_v; open half-spaces, no extra bounds; intersect with 0.1 < ILM.R < 0.8
face_atlas_profile.validation: Finite UV/scalars in [0,1], increasing crop and B V interval, positive finite aspect, increasing positive radii with outer <= 1
face_atlas_profile.binding: Private Face main material at actor setup; static fields only; invalid apply_material returns false atomically
face_atlas_profile.scope: No CPU classification/pivot/tag, skin coverage, ILM/SDF, wetness, shape algorithm or sample offline generator change; numeric checks do not prove semantic texture fit

comic_profile.required_when: authored comic placement or complete showcase
comic_profile.coordinate_space: actor rest space after display-height alignment; card offsets relative to the animated anchor and birth view plane
comic_profile.validation: Canonical performance bone; finite origins/offsets, positive finite card sizes and Vector4 XY centers/ZW sizes
comic_profile.binding: Read-only authored resource; caller applies static uniforms and owns animated anchor/lifecycle. Showcase preserves birth pinning and face SURFACE attachment
comic_profile.scope: Does not prove semantic fit, actual hair occlusion or second-character acceptance; shader front-domain threshold and shape algorithms remain unchanged

rain_profile.required_when: continuous surface rain or complete showcase
rain_profile.chart_encoding: raw RGBA8, size.x * size.y * 4 bytes; chart ID R + G * 256
rain_profile.vertex_encoding: raw little-endian RGBA float32, width 256, RG atlas UV, 16 bytes per pixel
rain_profile.validation: Existing res:// files, finite rows, array counts, index bounds, positive candidate area and binary lengths
rain_profile.configure: Explicit enabled, candidate arrivals per simulation second, seed, Vector3 skin/hosiery/clothing wetness, hosiery height and opacity; caller supplies valid values
rain_profile.scope: Does not prove binary semantics, reciprocal adjacency or correspondence to actual Body; sample camera anchors are test-only fixtures, legacy hidden bead assets removed

wetness_profile.channels: Body/eye/hair use R; material_regions RGBA = textile, coated/leather, polymer, metal
wetness_profile.eye_tear_uv_limit: Finite Vector2 components in [0,1]; strict frag_uv upper bounds; profile default (1,1), sample (0.26,0.32); zero disables standard nonnegative UV region
wetness_profile.validation: Nonempty Texture2D inputs with positive dimensions and valid eye_tear_uv_limit
wetness_profile.scope: Material textures and tear UV upper bounds; baked eye classification, closure gate and rain simulation data remain separate

equipment_profile.binding: Geometry JSON, material PackedScene, labels, performance bone names, swatch UVs and direct material mesh groups
equipment_profile.scope: Input validation and runtime/equipment assembly; semantic bone fit and visual quality require model-specific evidence

hosiery_profile.leg_ao_repair: Optional, disabled by default; UV min/max within [0,1], increasing finite actor-rest heights and G floor within [0,1]; existing left-side/domain/garment-alpha gates remain
hosiery_profile.body_preparation: runtime/hosiery/npr_garment_geometry.gd: install original single-surface unskinned Body before equipment/animation; unused CUSTOM0 and no blend shapes required
hosiery_profile.required_when: using the dynamic fitted hosiery layer or complete showcase
hosiery_profile.mask_channels: garment RGB: Body primary/secondary/trim dye weights; A: shared hosiery coverage and current AO mask; tulle/stitch R: Body authored layers, metric seams replace texture stitch output
hosiery_profile.cuff: cuff_band_width and cuff_stitch_width: finite positive metres; cuff_stitch_offset: finite nonnegative metres below selected height; bind both Body and fitted shell
hosiery_profile.textile_scale: textile_period_m: finite positive actor-rest period; textile_repeats: positive integer repeats per texture tile; shell_offset_m: finite nonnegative world offset under positive uniform scaling
hosiery_profile.normal_correction: Optional res:// JSON: schema 1, positive integer vertex_count, unique finite [index, source_xyz, normal_xyz] rows; validate original mesh-local positions within 0.00001 and nonzero normals before applying
hosiery_profile.validation: Six positive-size Texture2D inputs; finite increasing domain heights, finite positive half width and finite full-width threshold; semantic content requires visual evidence
hosiery_profile.scope: Textures, Body domain, sparse normal correction, cuff shape and textile scale; no full triangle topology proof or independent leg centers; nonuniform shell scaling is not supported by the offset formula

eye_geometry_profile.required_when: using diagnostic ocular geometry or complete showcase visual layers
eye_geometry_profile.binding: PackedScene and EyeL/EyeR actor-space landmark centers
eye_geometry_profile.scope: Asset, landmark, gaze, shading, shell and tear optics configuration; runtime/face/npr_face_rig.gd owns assembly, control, presentation and lifecycle; saved/UI state adapter remains in showcase
eye_geometry_profile.lid_sampling: face_motion_profile required; 65 uniformly spaced shared upper/lower X columns per side

symbol_surface_profile.required_when: using symbolic replacement surfaces or the complete showcase visual layers
symbol_surface_profile.binding: replacement mesh centers/radii, glyph scales and face/outline shader masks
symbol_surface_profile.scope: Procedurally fitted symbolic replacement surfaces; authored closure and visual fit need independent review

hair_dynamics_data_path.scope: Dynamic chain, skin and contact input structure; physical/style quality needs model-specific evidence

soft_tissue_data_path.required_when: using the authored pressure corrective in showcase performance
soft_tissue_data_path.scope: Sparse authored corrective; collision and domain metadata are not general collision validation

rig_layout_data_path.required_when: using authored skeleton diagnostics in showcase
rig_layout_data_path.coordinate_space: actor rest space after display-height alignment
rig_layout_data_path.scope: Ordered standard bones, acyclic parent references and finite nonzero endpoints; does not prove anatomical fit or animation quality

performance_data_path.scope: Skin palettes, sampled actions and face deltas; dynamic hair, soft tissue and symbolic surfaces remain separate datasets

face_motion_profile.required_when: using procedural eye motion and sliding lid features
face_motion_profile.binding: character-authored expression resource, UV/component calibration and lid JSON
face_motion_profile.scope: P05-A eye/lid calibration only; full speech, rig and symbolic-surface data are not yet generalized

material_set.source_mode_purpose: optional extension textures, local axes and outline smooth-normal sources only

material_profile.optional_features_default: disabled or zero-strength; exact legacy-look no-op

conditional_attributes.TEXCOORD_1: face when sdf_on_uv2 is true; any role when outline smooth-normal source is UV2 oct
conditional_attributes.TANGENT: hair anisotropy/flow, or any role when outline smooth-normal source is tangent

geometry.equipment: merge disconnected islands into body surface and atlas
geometry.custom_vertex_displacement: unsupported by depth, shadow and picking synchronization

enum.2: octahedral smooth normal stored in UV2

outline_smooth_normal_source.conflict: anisotropic hair needs the authored strand tangent; use UV2 for smooth outline normals when both features are enabled

channels.R: unused by current body ILM math

body_lut.space: raw; RGB color rows explicitly decoded by shader
body_lut.filter: nearest, no repeat, no mipmap sampling

dissolve_noise.purpose: shared color, eye-stencil, outline, auxiliary-depth and shadow-caster visibility

atlas_rules.face_sdf_uv: UV1 or UV2 without fragment Y flip; mirror X for negative local light angle
atlas_rules.eye_stencil_uv: UV1 with fragment Y flip, independent of SDF UV2
atlas_rules.sdf_light_test: A greater than normalized absolute horizontal light angle is lit

body_lut_rows.0: RGB specular color, manual sRGB decode
body_lut_rows.1: R legacy exponent, G feather, B intensity; explicit float profile overrides exponent
body_lut_rows.5: RGB rim-shadow color, manual sRGB decode
body_lut_rows.6: R rim width, G feather, B bloom intensity
body_lut_rows.7: RGB bloom color, manual sRGB decode

source_material_mode.binding_order: duplicate source Body, Face/eye and Hair/eye-hair chains, then bind optional uniforms to the private copies

motion_vectors.source: custom Godot RD mesh-instance double-buffered deformed vertices
motion_vectors.deformation_history: validated with consecutive adjacent-frame pose changes
motion_vectors.isolated_pose_jump_after_long_idle: may be treated as teleport/no continuous previous deformation

scope.example: original procedural integration mannequin; diagnostic atlases, not finished character art
scope.silver_wolf_acceptance_assets: samples/silver_wolf/assets/authoring/silver_wolf/optional is high-contrast diagnostic input; samples/silver_wolf/assets/authoring/silver_wolf/final is the current NPR 1.1 showcase control set; neither is canonical or recovered original-game art
